title: Renewable Ores & Minerals
description: Adds Vanilla style crafting recipes to make minerals (like Cinnabar) and ore blocks renewable!
body:
# Renewable Ores & Minerals
Made by [**8bitdino**](https://www.youtube.com/@8bitdino) with **100% human** trial & error :3
## Description
This datapack adds Vanilla-style ways to craft ore blocks and various mineral blocks that otherwise wouldn't be renewable! All mineral recipes take inspiration from their real-world counterparts' chemical composition and/or method of formation :)

Being able to craft ore blocks from processed ingots also allows for Raw Copper, Raw Gold, and Raw Iron to be renewable!

This is designed to work with my [Better Non-Renewables Collection](https://modrinth.com/collection/uglZSVKi)!
## Affected Blocks/Items
- Ancient Debris
- Calcite
- Cinnabar
- Stone and Deepslate Ores
  - Coal
  - Copper (and Raw Copper)
  - Diamond
  - Emerald
  - Gold (and Raw Gold)
  - Iron (and Raw Iron)
  - Lapis Lazuli
  - Redstone
- Gilded Blackstone
- Nether Gold Ore
- Nether Quartz Ore
- Netherrack
- Tuff
## Recipes Added
Recipes are shown in the Gallery. Crafting table recipes are based off similar existing recipes in the game (like Diorite) and some recipes exist to make others renewable.
## IMPORTANT
> NONE of the **ore blocks** will result in crafting infinite materials. All **ore block** recipes take the max amount of materials the ore can drop when using a Fortune III pickaxe.

> IF YOU HAVE ANY MODS OR DATAPACKS THAT ALLOW FOR FORTUNE LEVELS HIGHER THAN III, it will technically be possible to craft infinite ores.
## More
I haven't figured out a good way to make modular datapacks, so don't be afraid to go into the file and delete any .json files in the [recipe] folder you don't want!

Please let me know if any bugs/issues arise by submitting a report through the dedicated [Google Form](https://forms.gle/UnCkA96xm5q3CV6a8)!
